name: My Pet Caster
original_name: マイペットキャスター
source:
Chapter 5 of My pet series Fate edition.
Caster betrays her master and is captured as a result. She is led into the torture chamber, and violation begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《我的宠物》系列《Fate》篇第5章。
Caster背叛主人，并因此遭到俘虏。她被带入拷问室，侵犯随之开始。
